description:
Gaggle NTL superset: 223,056 labelled passages for the Kaggle “Name That LLM” competition (18 models), gathered from public open-licence datasets, with provenance on every row.

Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Every row’s original dataset allows republishing with credit (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or MIT). Rows whose licence couldn’t be confirmed are left out, including all rows built from olegzholobov’s response corpus (not relicensed).

Columns: text, model, prompt_group, source_label, via_dataset, via_licence, original_dataset, original_licence, retrieved, release (“v1” = the original 87,106 passages, “2026-10-28” = the expansion), row_in_pool, label_risk (crtproduction’s flag that a gemini-3.7 passage may have been served by gemini-3.8).

Credits: gaggle_ntl_superset_credits.csv lists all 105 original datasets with their licences and the dataset each came through. Thank you to all of them, and to crtproduction for the open pool with per-row licences.

No official competition passages are included, and near-copies of them were removed.
title: Gaggle NTL superset
